notes: tp4-switched with sparknet's switched NCCL profile in place of the four values it inherits from tp4-ring: at most 8 NCCL channels (tp4-ring 4), 1 MiB NCCL buffers (4 MiB), cuMem off (on), a 4 MiB one-shot all-gather cap (2 MiB). Image-independent: a candidate's tp4-switched arm takes the same set. On release the four values go into the recipe's tp4-switched environment; tp5..tp8-switched extend tp4-switched and keep tp4-ring's values until measured at their sizes (README).
